title: Four metrics from one confusion matrix
summary: Fill in precision, recall, F1 and accuracy from four counts.
text:
A fraud model flags 50 transactions: 40 are fraud (true positives) and 10 are not (false positives). It misses 20 frauds (false negatives) and correctly passes 130 transactions (true negatives).

- Precision is [[precision]]
- Recall is [[recall]]
- F1 is [[f1]]
- Accuracy is [[accuracy]]

If the team cares most about catching fraud, the metric to raise is [[priority]].
